record_type_quote: Claim for Review - The claim selected for replication from Brough et al 2016 is the Study 2 claim that participants who read about a character (either male or female) doing a green behavior (using a reusable shopping bag) give higher ratings of stereotypically female traits to that character. This claim is based on the following sentence from the paper’s abstract: “[C]onsumers who engage in green behaviors are stereotyped by others as more feminine”. The claim is tested using an F test on an index for femininity constructed from three rating items, with target’s behavior (green or non green) and gender (male or female) as independent variables.
